hooks.name: Block local formatCurrency definitions
hooks.description: Prevents regression of the formatCurrency duplication bug by blocking saves that introduce local formatCurrency definitions. Points to the centralized utility.

action.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$f = $args[0]; if ($f -and $f -ne 'lib\\utils\\textFormat.ts' -and $f -notmatch 'lib[/\\\\]utils[/\\\\]textFormat\\.ts') { $content = Get-Content $f -Raw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($content -match '(?m)^\\s*(const|function|let|var)\\s+formatCurrency|formatCurrency\\s*=\\s*\\(') { Write-Error \"BLOCKED: Local formatCurrency definition detected in $f. Use: import { formatCurrency } from '@/lib/utils/textFormat' instead.\"; exit 2 } }; exit 0" -- "${filePath}"
